sourceMethods: All 128 active subnet slots and 96 September 29–30 channel briefs reviewed.
Signed-in X organizer recap and latest Bittensor search read; 285 public account candidates sampled. Candidate list includes commentators and quoted accounts, not only subnet teams.
176 repository paths scanned; 16 selected commits inspected for substantive changes and deployment limits.
Signed-in AlphaGap 119-subnet leaderboard, SubnetRadar, TAO Daily, TAO Media and 34 current Moments reviewed.
September 23–29 editions compared for follow-ups, omissions and unresolved incidents. Full-roster market outliers and emission leaders reviewed.
YouTube Videos and Live tabs checked. New public September 30 episode and September 29 members upload verified by watch-page title, date and duration; October 1 SN49 Nepher stream retained.
accessGaps: Edition researched September 30 from 10:44 AM ET through 10:52 AM ET. It includes material September 29 announcements after the previous cutoff.
12 repository paths returned errors; 9 public account candidates exposed no usable post links. X sampling and search are not exhaustive; no Grok scan is claimed.
Channel briefs are AI-generated secondary summaries. Team-attributed reports remain developing; community statements do not establish deployment or support unverified allegations.
No purchases, bridge transfers, miner payouts or independent security/benchmark tests were performed. Product announcements, previews, code changes and production recovery are distinguished.

SN78 UMI's next cohort and reward restart, SN44 Score's scoreboard recovery, SN55 NIOME's scoring investigation and unrestricted SN94 Cathedral mining remain unconfirmed. SN108 ChipForge activation remains a future target.

SN82 identity remains unverified after re-registration; its seven-day return spans the transition. SN10 Pareton and SN53 engy feeds did not supply new production benchmarks for their announced partnership.

decisions.reason: The 20.35% 24-hour alpha/TAO move prompted a primary review. The team reports initial emissions and mining revenue across three subnets; unnamed partnership and completed buybacks remain unverified. No price causation inferred.

The 128.41% seven-day return spans the former project deregistration and a new registration. Current identity is not verified; the archived old channel and price move do not establish a fresh catalyst for the former project.

editorialDecisions: SN4 earns five stars for two primary-confirmed live compute products, not market movement. No X post authorization for this daily run.
SN120 Base token access and the postponed evaluation fork are separate stories. The 14:00 UTC deadline was explicitly canceled in code; no replacement time asserted.
Carbon fundraising and competition win confirmed by Bitstarter and organizer; no invented SN number, mainnet launch or audited settlement.
SN107 phone is a remote companion to a Mac demonstration, not proof that an iPhone performs mining. Studio access is limited to approved researchers.
SN118 product roadmap is separate from screening backlog. Reported past IM fixes do not establish current admission/reward recovery. No completed buybacks asserted.
SN54 public Pulse page and Gate differ in custody wording; story focuses on demonstrated approvals and allowances rather than claiming assets move into a particular custody structure.
SN10/SN53 partnership presentation checked against both feeds; no new performance measurement or commercial terms found.
SN122 outlier covered with timestamp and currency. Partner teaser remains unnamed and price movement is not evidence of causation.
SN82 deregistration/registration already covered, identity unresolved; historic seven-day move excluded as a catalyst.
SN17 official judged winners resolve the earlier event watch; no inferred community-vote result or prize payment.
SN20 zero-burn implementation supersedes yesterday’s code policy, but applied finalized weights and payouts not verified.
SN97 fixes supported by public code. Community ban/deployment claims are not team-confirmed. SN91 copying allegations and SN55 seed allegations are not republished as fact.
SN94 TDX test uses injected binding and leaves production gates open. SN117 CLI first release pending, not publicly downloadable mining launch.

SN38 live product and model-size roadmap already covered. New presentation repost contains no independently verified new model release. SN64 phone demonstration, SN9 SDK, SN85 streaming, SN80 Shift and SN66 DEFLATE launch already covered; no repeat launch items.
SN63 RSA 530 milestone already announced earlier; promised solution repository not verified published. SN78 next-cohort/reward recovery not confirmed.
SN49 Phase 3 deadline passed but no new results in official feed; publish environment preparation only. SN88 first conviction payout remains scheduled October 1, not completed.
SN110 facility is planned for end October. SN96 marketplace applications are not listings; new secondary consolidation article does not independently certify ownership transfer.
SN112 acquisition agreement already covered September 23; current media headline not sufficient to assert a new completed transfer.

Emission leaders SN51, SN64, SN4, SN107, SN53, SN44, SN8, SN3, SN80, SN15, SN68 and SN9 checked. SN51 default-off fixes, SN8 buyback projections, SN3 ongoing training and SN44 promotional overview do not establish new launches or recoveries.

Moments reviewed: SN17 99.999 alpha lock at block 9178652, 2026-09-30T05:38:48.637Z and SN75 484.575 alpha lock at block 9176294, 2026-09-29T21:43:48.344Z are routine additions, not ownership changes. Other wallet-flow labels do not establish motives or causes; no material new deregistration or ownership event selected.
Latest public 1J8va16QaMQ: 2684 seconds, September 30. Latest member FqFmRffEgVU: 552 seconds, September 29. Previous member entry preserved; removed/postponed videos remain absent.
Unrelated StonkFun, generic crypto/AI news and quoted sports accounts excluded. Past editions preserved.
